name: The Impossible Show
flavor: The whole tent disappears. In its place: whatever you need everyone to believe is standing here instead - a burning building, a bottomless pit, an army that was never hired.
description:
You remake a piece of the world. A 60-foot cube within range fills with a fully realised illusory environment — sight, sound, temperature, even scent — and it can be anything you can picture: a collapsed tunnel, a wall of roaring fire, a chasm where the floor used to be, a cheering crowd of a hundred phantom performers. It needs no concentration and holds for the duration while you do whatever else you like.

**While it stands, it behaves like the thing it depicts.** It blocks line of sight through it, its area is difficult terrain, and **every creature inside it has disadvantage on every attack roll, ability check and saving throw it makes** — nobody fights well inside a rockfall they believe in. This applies to your allies too, so place it as a hazard to be worked around rather than a blanket to fight under. It is still an image: it deals no damage, supports no weight, and stops nothing that does not care what it sees.

**One creature seeing through it ends the whole thing.** A creature can spend its action to study the illusion and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}; a creature that shoves through it may make that check as part of the movement, since contact gives the game away. On any success the illusion **collapses immediately and entirely, for every creature at once** — it does not linger as an image and it does not go on fooling anyone who failed. That is the counter-play, and it costs a single enemy a single action to find it.

**Once before it ends**, as a bonus action, you can make the whole thing enact a single dramatic moment: the phantom army charges, the fire roars up, the floor gives way. Every creature of your choice inside it or within 10 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or be frightened of it until the end of its next turn and, if it has a reaction available, use that reaction to move as far from the illusion as its speed allows.
narration: The tent is gone. In its place is a rockfall, or a fire, or a drop into nothing — cold on your face, loud in your ears, entirely in the way, and nobody caught inside it can think straight. It holds until one person stops and really looks, and then there was never anything there at all.
sheetSummary: Once per combat. Action, 120 ft, 60-ft cube, costs 3 Phantasm, up to 10 minutes, no concentration. While it stands: blocks line of sight, difficult terrain, and EVERY creature inside has disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws — allies included. Any creature can spend its action (or push through it) to make an Investigation check vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}; ANY success collapses the whole illusion immediately for everyone. Once before it ends, bonus action: creatures of your choice inside or within 10 ft make a Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or are frightened until the end of their next turn and must use a reaction to flee it. Deals no damage.
